evidence.title: HBM3/HBM3E Production Capacity and Supply Concentration 2026
evidence.summary: SK Hynix, Samsung, and Micron combined HBM3/HBM3E production capacity: ~1.2 million units/month as of 2026. SK Hynix leads with ~55% share (~660k units/month); Samsung ~30% (~360k units/month); Micron ~15% (~180k units/month). Total addressable datacentre AI-accelerator demand now exceeds capacity; lead times for new HBM orders range 4-6 months.
evidence.excerpt: HBM supply concentration: SK Hynix 55%, Samsung 30%, Micron 15%; total 1.2M units/month capacity; 4-6 month lead times.

evidence.title: HBM Stack Assembly Yield and OSAT Capacity
evidence.summary: HBM stack assembly (vertical die bonding with micro-bumps and TSV connections) yield: 65-70%. OSAT suppliers (Amkor, JSC, SPIL) collectively available for ~900k HBM stacks/month at mature yield; specialized hybrid bonders have 14-18 month lead time for procurement and installation.
evidence.excerpt: HBM assembly yield 65-70%; OSAT capacity ~900k stacks/month; bonding equipment lead time 14-18 months.

evidence.title: HBM Post-Assembly Test Yield and ATE Bottleneck
evidence.summary: Post-assembly HBM functional test yield (after micro-bump bonding and initial burn-in): 60-65%. HBM-specific automatic test equipment (ATE) scarcity: only 4-5 vendors globally (LTX-Credence, Xcerra, FormFactor, Credence Systems, StarT) support HBM characterization at full 1.2 GHz+ memory speeds; test equipment utilization rates >90% across industry.
evidence.excerpt: HBM test yield 60-65% post-assembly; only 4-5 global ATE vendors; test equipment utilization >90%.

evidence.title: HBM Test and Assembly Equipment Lead Times
evidence.summary: Custom HBM functional/characterization ATE delivery lead time: 14-18 months from order. Hybrid bonder equipment (required for multi-layer die stacking): 12-16 month lead time. In 2024-2026, HBM test equipment has been the gating constraint on OSAT throughput expansion.
evidence.excerpt: HBM ATE lead time 14-18 months; hybrid bonder 12-16 months; equipment is gating OSAT throughput.

evidence.title: 400G/800G Optical Transceiver Production Capacity and Market Share
evidence.summary: 400G/800G QSFP-DD and OSFP optical transceiver module production: ~50-60 million units/year industry-wide (2026 estimate), dominated by Broadcom (~35-40%), Cisco (~20-25%), Arista/Mellanox (~15-20%), others. Single-sourcing risk on long-reach optics (1310nm EML/DFB lasers); lead times 8-12 weeks for 400G transceiver modules.
evidence.excerpt: 400G QSFP-DD production ~50-60M units/year; Broadcom ~35-40% share; lead times 8-12 weeks.

evidence.title: VCSEL and EML/DFB Laser Supply for Optical Transceivers
evidence.summary: VCSEL array and photodiode array supply: primary suppliers Broadcom, Foxconn, Lumentum, Mitsubishi Electric. Short-reach (850nm) VCSELs: widely available. Long-reach (1310nm) EML/DFB laser diodes: constrained. Lumentum supplies ~40% of coherent optics market; lead time 12-16 weeks due to compound semiconductor fab constraints.
evidence.excerpt: VCSEL arrays widely available; 1310nm EML/DFB lasers constrained; Lumentum 40% market share; 12-16 week lead times.

evidence.title: HDI Backplane Substrate Production Capacity and Lead Times
evidence.summary: High-density interconnect (HDI) backplane substrate production (12-20 layers, 3-4µm trace/space): dominated by Isola, Shengyi, Wus Printed Circuit. Global HDI capacity for datacenter-grade backplanes: ~8-12 million units/year; lead time 6-8 weeks. Constraint: advanced lamination equipment for ultra-thin dielectric layers.
evidence.excerpt: HDI backplane capacity ~8-12M units/year; 6-8 week lead time; constraint is lamination equipment.

evidence.title: Advanced Organic Substrate for Chiplet Interconnect
evidence.summary: Advanced organic substrate for chiplet interconnect (3µm trace/space, 2-10 metal layers): supplied primarily by Ibiden, Samsung Electro-Mechanics (SEM), Shinko Electric, Unimicron. Combined capacity ~6-8 million substrate units/year at leading edge. Lead time for 3nm-class organic substrates: 8-12 weeks.
evidence.excerpt: Chiplet substrate (3µm trace/space) capacity ~6-8M units/year; lead time 8-12 weeks; Ibiden, SEM, Shinko, Unimicron dominate.

evidence.title: CoWoS Package Substrate and Silicon Interposer Capacity
evidence.summary: Package substrate and silicon interposer (CoWoS architecture): TSMC provides substrate ~50% of AI-accelerator packages; Ibiden and Samsung SEM provide remainder. Total industry capacity for advanced substrates: ~40-50 million wafer equivalents/year. CoWoS substrate lead time: 10-14 weeks as of 2026.
evidence.excerpt: CoWoS substrate capacity ~40-50M wafer-equiv/year; TSMC 50% share; lead time 10-14 weeks.

evidence.title: Advanced Node MOSFET and GaN Supply for Power-Stage ICs
evidence.summary: Power-stage ICs (integrated MOSFET/GaN + driver in 5nm/7nm): global 5nm/7nm capacity ~350k wafers/month equivalent. TSMC supplies ~45% (~158k wpm), Samsung ~15% (~52k wpm), Intel ~12% (~42k wpm), others ~28% (~98k wpm). AI-accelerator VRM demand growing ~20%/quarter; allocation issues expected through 2026.
evidence.excerpt: Advanced node capacity 350k wpm; TSMC 45%, Samsung 15%, Intel 12%; allocation risk high.

evidence.title: Sealed-Loop Liquid Cooling Systems for AI Accelerators
evidence.summary: Sealed-loop liquid cooling systems (micropump, cold plate, manifold) for AI accelerators: Asetek dominates with ~60% share of datacenter sealed-loop market (~8-10M unit annual demand in 2026). CoolIT, Iceotope, LiquidCool Solutions provide remainder. Supply constraint: specialized manifold/connector fittings; lead time 10-14 weeks.
evidence.excerpt: Sealed-loop cooling market ~8-10M units/year; Asetek 60% share; lead time 10-14 weeks.
